summary: One test failed due to inability to locate the form element with role 'form' and name 'Contact Form'. The test expected the form to be visible but it was not found, causing the failure.
rootCause: The test failed because the locator getByRole('form', { name: 'Contact Form' }) did not find any matching element. This indicates a mismatch between the selector used in the test and the actual application markup or accessible name of the form element.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify Accessibility of Contact Form
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator).toBeVisible() failed: Locator getByRole('form', { name: 'Contact Form' }) did not find any element. Protocol error (Runtime.callFunctionOn): Internal server error, session closed.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector mismatch due to incorrect or missing accessible name 'Contact Form' on the form element in the application under test.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the form element in the application has the correct accessible role 'form' and accessible name 'Contact Form'. Update the selector if the accessible name or role has changed. Also, check for any application rendering issues that might prevent the form from appearing.

recommendations: Review the application markup to confirm the form has role='form' and accessible name 'Contact Form'.
If the accessible name differs, update the test selector accordingly.
Check application logs or UI to ensure the form is rendered and visible at the time of test execution.
Investigate the protocol error 'Internal server error, session closed' for potential environment or browser instability, though it appears secondary to the selector issue.
Rerun the test after fixing the selector or application accessibility attributes.
releaseImpact: High - The failing test verifies accessibility of a critical contact form. The issue must be resolved before release to ensure accessibility compliance and functionality.
